1661-4359-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-5332.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4094-5086-5183-5231-7743.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4094-5086-5183-5231-7743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1624-6108-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1628-3490-6797-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-3490-6797-7426.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-1849-2511-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7153.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-7060.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-7060.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

874-2034-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2034-2866-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1495-3062-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Pir.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-3062-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

3234-3293-4050-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4050-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-4050-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

643-3767-3918-4306.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
643-3767-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
643-3767-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1987-3277-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3277-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Izzet Chronarch.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

204-1858-2056-2633-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-4885.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

231-916-3390-4273.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Copy Artifact by paying {1}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Vault of Whispers.
Activate Copy Artifact by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Copy Artifact from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-1633-2039-5184-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-2039-5184-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

235-1811-2942.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target a single creature and deal damage to it.
You have enough mana to pay for the instant or sorcery.
235-1811-2942.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying the spell for each other creature you control the spell could target, ensuring that Imodane's copy is put onto the stack first.
Resolve the first copy, dealing three times the listed amount of damage to the targeted creature.
Imodane triggers, dealing nine times the listed amount of damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining copy.

1642-2129.notablePrerequisites:
Scytheclaw attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with Scytheclaw attached.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-2129.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Scytheclaw attached.
Scytheclaw triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

627-654-1021-2034.description:
Play Drownyard Temple triggering landfall.
Tap Drownyard Temple for {C}.
Use Amulet of Vigor to untap Drownyard Temple and Embodiment of Fury to make Drownyard Temple a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Play Drownyard Temple from your graveyard.
Amulet of Vigor untaps it.
Repeat.

1202-3249-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding one mana of any color.
Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Myr Moonvessel.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.
